tools.name: businesses_search
tools.description: Search local businesses from Google Business Profiles. 23M+ businesses with ratings, reviews, website contacts, socials and ad pixels. 30 per page. Charges 1 credit per business with an email or phone and 0.5 per business without. saveToContacts also stores them in your contacts.

tools.name: organizations_search
tools.description: Search organizations, or look them up by domain. Charges 0.5 credits per returned organization. limit 0 returns only totalCount, free.

tools.name: organizations_enrich
tools.description: Enrich a company from its domain. Returns the company's firmographics, socials and website data. Charges 0.5 credits only when the company is found.

tools.name: organizations_find_decision_maker
tools.description: Find the decision maker of an organization with a verified email. Charges 2 credits only when a decision maker is found. Can take a few minutes.

tools.name: persons_search
tools.description: Search persons with their emails and phones. Covers professional contacts only: people in their role at a company, not private individuals. Returns only people with an email or phone, with full contact data, and charges 1 credit per returned person. Page with nextOffset. limit 0 returns only totalCo

tools.name: persons_lookup
tools.description: Look up one person by LinkedIn URL, email, or name and company domain. Returns the person with their emails, phones, role and company. Covers professional contacts only: people in their role at a company, not private individuals. Charges 1 credit only when the person is found with an email or phone.

tools.name: persons_find_email
tools.description: Find a person's work email by LinkedIn URL, or full name and company domain. Charges 1 credit only when an email is found.

tools.name: persons_find_phone
tools.description: Find a person's phone number by LinkedIn URL, email, or full name and company domain. Covers professional contacts only: people in their role at a company, not private individuals. Charges 2 credits only when a phone number is found.

tools.name: websites_find_contacts
tools.description: Find the emails, phones and social profiles published on a company website. Reads what our own crawl of the website found, so it answers in under a second and never visits the site during the call. A website that many businesses share (a site builder, a booking platform) has no contacts. Charges 0.5

tools.name: websites_find_pixels
tools.description: Find the ad and analytics pixels a website runs. Checks the homepage and every Google Tag Manager container it loads, nested ones included, for meta, tiktok, openai, google_analytics, google_ads, microsoft_ads, linkedin, pinterest, snapchat, x, reddit, hotjar, microsoft_clarity, callrail. Containers

tools.name: contacts_create
tools.description: Save your own contacts or organizations. Free. Existing contacts are matched and kept, never duplicated.

tools.name: contacts_list
tools.description: List your contacts in a stable order; page with nextBefore

tools.name: campaigns_list
tools.description: List your email campaigns, newest first, with their status and counts

tools.name: campaigns_get
tools.description: One campaign with its steps, sender pool and counts

tools.name: campaigns_create
tools.description: Create an email campaign; it starts paused. Free. Add recipients with campaigns_add_recipients, then turn it on with campaigns_set_status.

tools.name: campaigns_update
tools.description: Change a campaign’s name, steps, sender pool or daily limit. Only the fields sent change. steps replaces every step: send a step with its id to keep its personalization and past versions.

tools.name: campaigns_set_status
tools.description: Turn a campaign on, pause it, or archive it. active needs a sender pool with an active inbox. Setting paused on an archived campaign unarchives it.

tools.name: campaigns_add_recipients
tools.description: Add your contacts to a campaign. Free. Contacts already in the campaign, without a usable email or not among your contacts are skipped.

tools.name: campaign_ideas_list
tools.description: List your campaign ideas and how far each got. Poll about once a minute while suggesting is true or an idea is drafting or launching.

tools.name: campaign_ideas_get
tools.description: One campaign idea with its draft: audience size and example emails

tools.name: campaign_ideas_suggest
tools.description: Suggest campaign ideas from your company profile. Free. Answers at once; the ideas show in campaign_ideas_list once suggesting is false, replacing every idea not launched yet. With segment it adds ideas for that audience instead.

tools.name: campaign_ideas_set_audience
tools.description: Set the Google Maps categories a Maps idea reaches. On a launched idea, recipients not contacted yet who no longer fit are taken out; removedRecipients counts them.

tools.name: campaign_ideas_set_radius
tools.description: Set how many miles around your home city a Maps idea reaches. On a launched idea, recipients not contacted yet outside the new radius are taken out; removedRecipients counts them.

tools.name: campaign_ideas_launch
tools.description: Draft each idea, create its campaign and turn it on. Answers at once. Each idea shows launching in campaign_ideas_list, then launched with its campaign once created.

tools.name: campaign_ideas_delete
tools.description: Delete a campaign idea that has no campaign. An idea that launched a campaign, or is launching, stays; archive its campaign instead.

tools.name: deliverability_create_test
tools.description: Start an inbox placement test for a mailbox you send from. Send one email from the mailbox you want to test to every address in seedEmails, with the testId anywhere in the body, then poll deliverability_get_test about once a minute to see whether it landed in the inbox, spam or a tab at Gmail, Outlo

tools.name: deliverability_get_test
tools.description: Where the test email landed at each seed mailbox. Poll about once a minute while status is waiting. placement is inbox, spam, promotions, social, updates or forums, missing while the email has not arrived, or unreadable while we could not read that seed mailbox; score is the inbox share from 0 to 10

tools.name: credits_get
tools.description: Current credit balance

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: businesses_search, persons_search, websites_find_contacts, campaigns_list, campaign_ideas_get, deliverability_get_test · Private data: businesses_search, persons_search, persons_lookup, persons_find_phone, websites_find_contacts, contacts_create, contacts_list, campaigns_add_recipients · Public sink: businesses_search, organizations_find_decision_maker, persons_search, persons_lookup, persons_find_email, persons_find_phone, websites_find_contacts, campaigns_list, campaigns_create, campaigns_update, campaigns_add_recipients, deliverability_create_test, deliverability_get_test · Destructive: campaign_ideas_delete.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: businesses_search, persons_search, websites_find_contacts, campaigns_list, campaign_ideas_get, deliverability_get_test · Private data: businesses_search, persons_search, persons_lookup, persons_find_phone, websites_find_contacts, contacts_create, contacts_list, campaigns_add_recipients · Public sink: businesses_search, organizations_find_decision_maker, persons_search, persons_lookup, persons_find_email, persons_find_phone, websites_find_contacts, campaigns_list, campaigns_create, campaigns_update, campaigns_add_recipients, deliverability_create_test, deliverability_get_test · Destructive: campaign_ideas_delete

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "businesses_search" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.
